11.title: Verify ipv6 dns server works for ping service
11.result:
1. Go to Network>DNS page, change the view to IPv6
  2. Select Specify IPv6 DNS Servers Manually
  3. Type in the DNS server address as DNS Server 1/2/3
  4. Go to System>Diagnostics page, select Ping
  5. Ping a FQDN record which is added on the IPv6 DNS Server
  =========Edit by Celia==========
  In step3, should enable "Prefer IPv6 DNS Servers";
  before step5, should enable "Prefer IPV6 Networking"
